questions.q: How many teams compete in the 2026 World Cup?
questions.explanation: 2026 is the first World Cup with 48 teams.

questions.q: How many World Cups has Brazil won?
Which team was famously eliminated in the group stage of both 2010 and 2014?
questions.explanation: Italy were eliminated in the group stage in both 2010 and 2014.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Ball at the 2022 World Cup?
questions.explanation: Messi won the Golden Ball as best player of the tournament.

questions.q: Who is the all-time top scorer in World Cup history?
questions.explanation: Miroslav Klose holds the record with 16 World Cup goals.

questions.q: Which country hosts the most matches in 2026?
questions.explanation: The USA hosts 78 of the 104 matches in 2026.

questions.q: Which African country reached the World Cup semi-final in 2022?
questions.explanation: Morocco became the first African team in a World Cup semi-final.

questions.q: Which player has scored in 4 different World Cups?
questions.explanation: Both Pelé and Cristiano Ronaldo have scored in 4 different World Cups.

questions.q: Which country won the first ever World Cup in 1930?
questions.explanation: Uruguay hosted and won the inaugural 1930 World Cup.

questions.q: How many goals did Diego Maradona score in the 1986 World Cup?
questions.explanation: Maradona scored 5 goals in 1986, including the 'Hand of God' and 'Goal of the Century'.
